patch_description:
This version replaces the zero-point placeholder with a deterministic maximin optimizer for the 11-point Heilbronn triangle problem.

It fixes the three vertices of the containing equilateral triangle, optimizes the remaining eight points in barycentric coordinates, and maximizes the minimum normalized area over all 165 point triples. The primary search uses seeded differential evolution, followed by constrained SLSQP polishing when SciPy is available. Results are cached after the first call, so repeated calls are effectively constant time.

A deterministic NumPy-only fallback arrangement is included for environments without SciPy or when optimization fails.
